rules: 先冻结需求、断言和测量口径，再跑对照
不能通过填充输入抬高缓存占比
不能丢失约束来缩短输入
失败与未达标实验保留
不为得到71%人为配比故障或挑选样本
每个目标分开跟踪，未完成不能整体结项

cache.scope: ABBA fixed six-turn scenario with two compressions each run; two optimized repeats, not universal stability

completion.scope: Current structured-output workers and shopping summary; 13 business cases x normal/429/prestream controlled strata, not natural traffic

preference.scope: 12 synthetic development queries, 24 labeled positives, age-balanced; all dislikes kept

parallel.scope: Current structured-output workers; paired worker phase, 2 repeats; excludes planning/synthesis; threshold remains workload-dependent

diagnosis.changes: Correlated model failure events survive successful retries; diagnostic CLI reports initial failure separately from consequences

long_context.scope: 12 real shopping turns per run, ABBA, forced compression boundaries; includes summary calls; no cost or latency improvement claimed

cross_language.scope: Same 12 synthetic English development queries; query rewriting plus structured worker output, not embedding-only or BM25

retrieval.scope: 67 existing development queries, rules vs rules+BGE, retrieval/model/dataset sources verified unchanged; not BM25 or Top100

remaining_required_evidence.reason: Automatic evidence extraction cannot establish human elapsed time. No human records have been supplied.
